blocks.text: The secretary of the Board of Zoning Appeals shall cause all variances which are granted by the Board of Zoning Appeals to be filed of record with the Register of Deeds. (Ord. 20206 § 78, 9-10-19; Ord. 18288 § 16, 7-13-04. Code 1995 § 48-34.14. Formerly 2.45.150.)
